blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Olympic boxer Aira Villegas ended her Asian Games 2026 campaign in the first round, losing to India’s Sakshi by unanimous decision in the women’s 51kg boxing on Tuesday at Nishio Gymnasium. Villegas couldn’t stop the Indian’s aggression over three rounds, with four judges scoring the bout 30-27 and another giving Sakshi a 30-26 victory. Sakshi, meanwhile, advances to the next round against Kazakhstan’s Alua Balkibekova. Villegas, a 2024 Paris Olympics bronze medalist, was the flag bearer of Team Philippines on Saturday’s Aichi-Nagoya opening ceremonies. The Asian […]...
